page.overview:
Who is Bernaile Gelbarn?

She is stocky in appearance and wears her hair in beaded braids hanging well below her shoulders. She is 5'5 tall, with hazel eyes and pale brown hair.

She tends to be aloof in public, but can laugh and tell jokes with close friends.

She is strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . Among the ten ferrets, Bernaile is the third in hierarchy by strength and years of training. She is also second strongest of the White Ajah among the Rebel Aes Sedai of which we have information, only Carlinya Sorevin being stronger and Brendas her equal.

Born in , she goes to the White Tower in . After seven years as a novice and nine as Accepted, she is raised Aes Sedai in .
